comment: Written by QA from intake/INTAKE_CARD.md §6 and intake/alignment.json mesh_region_desc (not from builder code). Primary: flange top face -> XY @ z=0, material -z. Secondary/origin: cup A (-X) and cup B (+X) outer-wall axes, wall faces z 1.2-3.6, origin = midpoint of the two axes on the primary plane. Clock: feature_line cup A axis -> cup B axis = +X. Regions are datum-frame predicates used ONLY to select scan faces; the webs (1.9 mm wide at y=0, INTAKE_CARD E08) are excluded from the cup-wall selection by |y|>=1.5.

position.note: datum_audit.py supports one circle only; qa/scripts/datum_audit_pair.py fits both with datum_audit.py's own circle_irls and composes midpoint + feature_line clock
